linkedin.connect.acknowledge: I have read this. The account I connect is my own.
linkedin.connect.disclosure: Whytide reads LinkedIn through your own account, which you connect on the provider's page: Whytide never sees your password. It reads the business profile fields of the people who engage with the posts you choose, at most your daily read limit, 100 profiles by default, and only inside your working hours. It never sends anything from your account. LinkedIn may restrict an account it finds automated: connect an account you own, and only if you accept that risk.
linkedin.connect.failed: The connection did not complete. Try again.
